posts.name: Sangeetha Sampath
posts.cooked:
My specific doubt is on the topic: Debugging options during OPPE

My doubt is: Shall we open and use the tools given in the debugging options from the “question” tab. Will it be considered as malpractice since the tool will be opening in a new tab making the current tab inactive? Can anyone confirm please. @KaustubhIsMyName

Recommended:
Mention what you have done till now to find clarification on the doubt:

posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked: Yes, you can use any Debugging Tools Given in Question Tab and when you open that your inactive tab count is increased by 1 but don’t worry you whole Screen is Recorded and Team will not consider this as a Malpractice So, You can Use any debugging tool without Considering Inactive Tab Count Increasing.

posts.name: Ashok
posts.cooked: I use print statements wherever i want to see what my code is doing so that i dont have to move out of my tab. I know its not effective and may take more time as you have to do test run every time, but given the medium complex questions, i didnt find it eating up my time and served me well.
